boundary_scope: Distinct roots 1,-1 in Z collapse modulo 2; the general injectivity theorem applies modulo 3. These are separate exact Lean checks, not a replacement for the universal proof.
scope: Actual integral closure of Z in algebraic closure of Q, actual maximal ideal above p, actual ideal inertia and arithmetic p-power residue action. The comparison theorem does not assume arbitrary global lifts are Frobenius; it explicitly requires residue action. AbsoluteIntegralFrobenius independently constructs such decomposition elements. No ideal/valuation decomposition identification is claimed.
source_route: Generic geometric-sum root injectivity proof adapted from the checked local-ring proof in CyclotomicInertiaBridge; generalized to arbitrary ring homomorphisms between domains.
